name: purchase-approvals
description: Monorepo root — convenience scripts only (no workspace tool). backend/, frontend/ and mobile/ are independent packages.

scripts.build:ci: pnpm -C backend run build && pnpm -C frontend/host run build && pnpm -C frontend/requester run build && pnpm -C frontend/approver run build
scripts.test:ci: pnpm -C backend test && pnpm -C frontend/host test && pnpm -C frontend/requester test && pnpm -C frontend/approver test
scripts.demo:setup: pnpm -C backend run db:up && sleep 3 && pnpm -C backend run db:create-table && pnpm -C backend run db:seed
scripts.dev:front: concurrently -k -n host,req,app "pnpm -C frontend/host start" "pnpm -C frontend/requester start" "pnpm -C frontend/approver start"
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n back,front "pnpm run dev:back" "pnpm run dev:front"
